x.description: A `Tensor` or `SparseTensor`. Must be one of the following types: `half`, `float32`, `float64`.
constraints: x must be one of SparseTensor, half, float32, float64

output.description: A `Tensor` or `SparseTensor`, respectively. Has the same type as `x`. @compatibility(scipy) Equivalent to scipy.special.i1 @end_compatibility

constraints: The output tensor has the same shape as the input tensor
